notes: Characterized from AppConfig.init(from:) lines 785-787: `if entry.id.trimmingCharacters(...).isEmpty { entry.id = UUID().uuidString }`. The generated id is nondeterministic (a fresh UUID per decode), so this fixture cannot pin a literal expected id -- the Rust test asserts the decoded id is non-empty and not equal to the blank input instead of an exact string match. Rust's port generates via `Uuid::new_v4()` (the `uuid` crate, newly added as a runtime dependency for this step) rather than Foundation's UUID; the two produce different random bytes but the same hyphenated 36-character shape.
